svg.title: Hoare partition from start to finish
svg.desc: Read down the left column and then the right column. Choose saved pivot 8. Scan inward, swap 9 with 7, and advance. Scan again, swap 8 with 2, and advance. The cursors cross. Return j = 2, separating 7, 3, 2 from 8, 9.
svg.text: Start i at 0 and j at 4
Advance i to 1 and j to 3
Advance i to 3 and j to 2
